descriptors.scope: Passive finite-run observations; no leak-freedom or endurance claim.

limits: Single fixed order: control then fast, one ten-fixture block per policy, nine intervals each; not randomized/counterbalanced or long endurance.

Same loaded server, exact fixtures/numerics, serial submission and all durability/fault/source/free-space checks retained. Later arm may benefit or suffer from runtime age, warm state, ledger growth, and preceding proof filesystem activity.

Coordinator reports no root/agent Git/tests/file writes during either arm after18:39 last commit; same passive FD observer and sparse journal reads. Operational report, not proof of globally idle host.

Observed service times do not support faster kernels; client stall reduction exposes sampler wait. Six-percent observed gain is scoped evidence, not a causal effect estimate, cold request, general quality claim or public record.

method.client_gap: Next server execution_start minus preceding server execution_success; receive-span excess is local receive elapsed start-to-success minus server start-to-success, not an absolute one-way delay or removable GPU idle bound.
method.counts: Policy totals include all14 requests/fourfills, count checkpoint calls only, not explicit attempt/prompt/completion saves or event-log fsyncs. Fast/checkpoint event counts may change because delivery speed changes progress observations.
method.evidence: Hash-bound small metadata/source/log analysis only; no tensor rescan or endpoint actions.
method.primary: 25 generated frames per clip divided by mean of nine server-success intervals within each ten-emission block. Four fills and interblock verification/reset gap excluded. Playback 24fps.
method.stage_matching: For emitted fixture i, sampler receipt request i+2 (emitted_index matches), decoder and prompt-node receipts request i+4. Worker phases are elapsed service times spanning both sampler devices, not per-device busy utilization.

quality.comparison: Exact video/audio latent, image and waveform tensors in stored verifier receipts; independent full tensor proof reconstruction is owned by coordinator.
